profile.headline: Leading developer of Alsis, Neural Compact Model generator.
profile.summary:
I am a first year master student at UCLA, majoring in Electrical and Computer Engineering. I graduated UCLA undergraduate at 2019 December and started work at Samsung Electronics Visual Display Business from 2018 January as a system hardware engineer. I was at The Wall PM group and developed The Wall Professional S-BOX and The Wall luxury Mediabox from 2018 June to 2019 August. I had a 2years experience in system hardware development and I had implemented machine learning system design project for undergraduate capstone design. I had a 2 quarter lab experience at undergraduate which also had been in deep learning system design. 
 I have been interested in technology development and how it changes people's lives. I believe my background in electrical engineering would help me better understand in software development and how it applied to hardware.

positions.title: The Wall Product Manager Group Hardware Engineer
Internship
positions.description:
As a Samsung Electronics Global Intern, worked at Visual Display Business, Panel Development Lab, focusing on improving viewing angle for VA panel for QLED TV

Implemented a project to identify the relationship between analog gamma and viewing angle, which has been concluded that simple-analog gamma tuning influences viewing angle by changing the position and size of the bump occurring in the gamma curve.

positions.title: Real time behavior analysis machine learning system
positions.description:
A machine learning system that can recognize actual motion behaviors in real time using neural network classification
– The system classifies 5 different motions (walking, running, stair ascending, descending and jumping) and 3 different turnings (left, right and no turn) simultaneously using two independent neural networks and multi-layered neural network structure further classifies each motion into 3 different speeds and angular speeds at the second layer respectively
– Implemented by multiple Intel Edison chips, paired with SparkFun 9 Degree of Freedom sensors to record performer’s motion data which will be transmitted to a server Edison to be fed into a neural network
– System determines output of the motion in real time based on the training data previously fed into the system (minimum 85% accuracy by confusion matrix)
– Communication and file transfer between server and sensors are implemented by client/server model and Data generation and processing is implemented by producer/consumer model
– Source code: https://github.com/wyarakaw/Real-Time-Motion-Classification-System
– Demo Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Czktj8Hpm4

company.name: UCLA Henry Samueli School of Engineering and Applied Science

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• HHMI Undergraduate Researcher – Develop a holographic on-chip semen analysis imaging platform
• Design GUI based User Interface using QT creator
• Implement porting Auto-focus functions written in MATLAB to C++

positions.title: Advanced project (air mouse)
positions.description:
A wireless mouse that uses wrist movement to move the mouse pointer on a computer
– Built a separate receiver module containing a battery status checking circuit
– Soldered RF24, IMU, battery socket and two switches onto the air mouse module controlled by Arduino Pro Mini
– Implemented SPI, I2C and UART communication between receiver and air mouse modules
– Implemented wireless communication between two modules using RF24 which can send battery status and switch signal from the air mouse to the receiver
– Wrote an Arduino code synchronizing accelerometer data of air mouse to the mouse pointer on the PC screen
